# Fixture provenance

The seven owner-contributed device fixtures are distributed under MIT. Five are
sanitized N6 samples. [Device provenance and coverage](samples/README.md).

The 27 supernote-typescript fixtures retain their Apache-2.0 license.
[Upstream revision, filenames and checksums](supernote-typescript/README.md).
Fuzz seeds are the small serialized notebooks from snnote-go.

The composition baseline comes from snrender-lib's `tests/goldens.tsv` and
`tests/expected-dumps.sha256` at the release vendored in `internal/clib`, which
were regenerated with the sanitized samples. Copy both files together with the
samples. The former records scale-one FNV-1a hashes of the straight gray and
alpha planes on a white canvas. A dash identifies a page using platform image
decoding with no exact golden. The latter records canonical reader dump hashes.
The two additional one-page overlay marks come from [snrender-lib v1.0.0](https://github.com/altessa-s/snrender-lib/tree/v1.0.0).

overlay/ contains only upstream PDF test inputs. The three *.mark.pdf files are
generated by the pinned tests/check_overlay_geometry.py make() and fixture setup
loop, with exactly its dimensions, CropBoxes and document-coordinate blue markers.
mixed.pdf, encrypted.pdf, huge.pdf and empty.pdf use tests/check_overlay.py make().
source.pdf is the byte array from tests/source_pdf.h. The six remaining PDFs are
byte-for-byte copies of tests/data/pdf-seeds/*.pdf (appearances, forms, inherited
geometry and incremental updates). No PDF comes from another repository.
signed.pdf and appearance.pdf use the corresponding setup blocks verbatim from
tests/check_overlay_geometry.py.
SHA256SUMS records these inputs. Regenerate from immutable upstream Git objects
with Python and pypdf (generated here with pypdf 7.1.0):

```sh
python3 scripts/overlay-fixtures.py ../snrender-lib
```

Regeneration requires pypdf. The generator reads the checked-in marks for
highlight geometry. The paired PDFs contain only synthetic source markers.


`spd/` contains only synthetic SQLite/gray-alpha PNG drawings generated by the
copied MIT-licensed snrender-lib `tests/generate_spd.py` at v1.0.0. Regenerate:
`python3 testdata/spd/generate_spd.py testdata/spd`.

`pdf-text/` contains synthetic PDFs/rectangle files produced by snrender-lib
`tests/check_pdf_text.py` at v1.0.0, copied from its generated test outputs.
The generator is retained in that folder for provenance and regeneration. It
requires pypdf and an upstream `test_pdf_text` probe; run it with the probe path
and an output directory. Cases include every page rotation/offset, unions,
column selections, astral text, page indexes and exact rectangle edges.
All input text is artificial. No private book, mark or drawing is stored here.

`pdf-text/exception_cleanup.m` is a local synthetic PDFKit exception probe. It
injects 400 ordinary/allocation exceptions into page-count loading and selection
bounds. It verifies that upstream's plain-ARC cleanup releases every PDFDocument
and drains both engine autorelease pools before returning to the caller.
